summary:
Six preparation defects found:

1. **P1 — Built package copies are not bound to the frozen source.** [prepare.py:234](/Users/jagatranvo/.t3/worktrees/stateless/n12-wire-resume-oct22/scripts/native-parity/n12-wire/prepare.py:234) checks only `scratch/source`. Go, Python, TypeScript, Swift and regression corpora use additional copies under `packages`; their initial identities are never compared with the frozen manifest. Changes there can produce passing receipts while both source-stability flags remain true. **Fix:** verify each copy against its source manifest and compare source inputs’ membership/type/hash before and after builds/tests, accounting explicitly for generated outputs.

2. **P1 — Inherited corpus overrides bypass source binding.** [prepare.py:63](/Users/jagatranvo/.t3/worktrees/stateless/n12-wire-resume-oct22/scripts/native-parity/n12-wire/prepare.py:63) inherits the environment but records only selected overrides. Existing tests honor `STATELESS_VALUE_CORPUS` and other corpus variables, so they can read external, unmanifested fixtures instead of the copied corpus. **Fix:** explicitly bind these variables to the frozen copies, or record and hash their effective external inputs. Preserve compiler policy.

3. **P2 — TypeScript’s success assertion requires an unselected reporter.** [prepare.py:198](/Users/jagatranvo/.t3/worktrees/stateless/n12-wire-resume-oct22/scripts/native-parity/n12-wire/prepare.py:198) requires `# fail 0`, but invokes plain `node --test`. Node 23+ defaults to `spec` even with redirected stdout, falsely failing a successful suite. **Fix:** add `--test-reporter=tap`. [Node documentation](https://nodejs.org/api/test.html#test-reporters)

4. **P1 — Interrupted commands can outlive their finalized receipts.** [prepare.py:82](/Users/jagatranvo/.t3/worktrees/stateless/n12-wire-resume-oct22/scripts/native-parity/n12-wire/prepare.py:82) starts a separate process session, but kills/reaps it only on timeout. `KeyboardInterrupt` reaches log hashing while the child can continue writing logs/artifacts; ordinary SIGTERM has no cleanup handler. The timeout branch also discards the reaped exit code. **Fix:** terminate and reap the owned process group on every interrupted exit before hashing logs; retain termination reason and return code.

5. **P2 — Copy failures skip required after-snapshots.** [prepare.py:48](/Users/jagatranvo/.t3/worktrees/stateless/n12-wire-resume-oct22/scripts/native-parity/n12-wire/prepare.py:48) can abort on a copy mismatch, missing/nonregular source, or I/O error before entering the `try/finally` at line 130. Only `preparation-aborted.json` survives; source-after and partial-copy identities are absent. **Fix:** initialize the report and enclosing finalizer before copying, retaining best-effort after-snapshots on every failure.

6. **P2 — Artifact traversal omits directory-symlink contents.** [compare.py:119](/Users/jagatranvo/.t3/worktrees/stateless/n12-wire-resume-oct22/scripts/native-parity/n12-wire/compare.py:119) does not descend directory symlinks; `resolution_snapshot()` hashes only resolved files. An installed module directory symlink therefore records its target string without the imported files, allowing target contents to change undetected. **Fix:** reject directory symlinks in package trees or recursively manifest their resolved contents with cycle detection.

The five hosts use public imports; the Go isolation flags and Python isolated-wheel launch are present. No edits, builds, tests, harness execution, or commits performed. Kyoto execution and broad N12 acceptance remain open.
